scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @alloc/contracts && npm run build --workspace @alloc/test-support && npm run build --workspace @alloc/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration --workspace @alloc/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace @alloc/api
scripts.verify: npm run schema:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
